summary: Frontend-only test of new Login as an employee link on LoginPage. Verified all 6 scenarios at 390x844 mobile viewport: (1) initial login page shows 'Login as an employee' link under 'Sign in securely'; (2) clicking the link toggles the UI to Employee sign-in (heading 'Employee sign-in.', eyebrow 'EMPLOYEE ACCESS', submit button 'Sign in as employee') while preserving phone/password fields; (3) Raj Mehta (+91 98765 42100 / RajSecure@2026) successfully signed in via employee mode and reached the Field Desk dashboard; (4) admin credentials (9999999999 / Admin@123) attempted through employee mode were rejected with the exact error 'This sign-in is for field employees. Use administrator sign-in instead.' and UI remained on the Employee sign-in screen (usable, no crash); (5) 'Administrator sign-in' link returned to standard mode ('Sign in to your field desk.') and admin logged in successfully; (6) no horizontal overflow at 390px width (scrollWidth = clientWidth = 390) before or after login.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.jsx line 31 is a single massive JSX line (>1500 chars). Consider splitting into multi-line JSX for readability/maintainability.

Admin-in-employee-mode guard is client-side only (calls /auth/logout after successful login). This is acceptable as a UX guard but note the admin session is briefly created server-side; ensure that is acceptable from an audit-log perspective.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employee login toggle feature is fully working. Selectors: employee-login-link, administrator-login-link, login-phone-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, login-error-message, login-page. Use administrator sign-in instead.'
